purpose: Apply final export-only presentation and quantity-namespace clarifications without changing the frozen 155-entry membership or rewriting the modular audit trail.
rules: Institution normalization changes only current-institution display strings; source rows remain unchanged.
Serial-set endpoints remain serial namespaces and are not presented as extant institutional slide counts unless the source independently states a surviving total.
Mixed-period group totals are explicitly qualified when they could otherwise be mistaken for a nineteenth-century subtotal.
No relationship, attribution, date, source URL, provenance grade, or membership decision is changed by this overlay.
